text: This photo is Bui Ba Den. There's machine guns on top of the rock. There's rocks everywhere on the top of the mountain making it hard to walk around. Every step you take is a different angle. At night when getting attacked I would run to the mortar pit and one time i ran into a big bamboo ladder they put up next to a building and it knocked me cold. I was out for a few hours. captain Kennedy was standing over me when I came too.
